'''Groonor''' was a [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. Having retired at some point before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]],<ref name="TOR" /> by around [[3643 BBY]]<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates/1|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "One Last Job" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> he had returned for a final job of delivering [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] through dangerous territory.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], an individual associated with one of the two rival factions sent a companion of theirs to serve as a security escort for Groonor. The shipment was attacked by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], but the companion was able to protect the cargo and saved Groonor's life. Grateful, the Chevin offered them a bonus.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Groonor was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "One Last Job" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="TOR" />
